name: Article 9 – paragraph 1 – 427
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on circularity requirements for vehicle design and on management of end-of-life vehicles, amending Regulations (EU) 2018/858 and 2019/1020 and repealing Directives 2000/53/EC and 2005/64/EC
part_text: 1. The manufacturer shall submit the data required to meet circularity and recyclate requirements once per year, in application of the once-only principle, via the relevant national authorities. Dual or parallel reporting obligations shall be out of the question. The Commission and Member States shall optimise existing reporting systems and make sure that small and medium-sized enterprises in particular do not face a disproportionate burden.*
